prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” personal injury lawyer for every Atlanta car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on your case facts (injury severity, liability dispute, whether the other driver is insured, whether you need a lawyer who will actually go to trial, etc.). I can help you find a strong match. First, a few quick pointers and next steps.

What matters when choosing the best lawyer for your case
- Relevant experience: look for lawyers who focus on car-accident and serious-personal-injury work and who have trial experience when needed.  
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts, especially for cases similar to yours.  
- Resources: the firm should be able to advance costs for medical records, experts, and litigation if your case requires it.  
- Communication: prompt, clear responses and a lawyer/team who keeps you updated.  
- Fee structure: most take cases on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Ask the contingency percentage and who pays court/expert fees if you lose.  
- Reputation and discipline history: check peer reviews and state bar records.  
- Local experience: familiarity with Atlanta/Georgia courts and local medical providers is a plus.

Immediate steps you should take (if not already done)
- Get medical care and keep records/receipts.  
- Preserve evidence: photos, police report, witness contacts.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without consulting a lawyer.  
- Note deadlines: Georgia generally has a 2-year statute of limitations for personal injury suits (there are exceptions), so don’t delay.

How to vet candidates quickly
- Use Georgia Bar (gabar.org) to confirm license/discipline record.  
- Look at client and peer-review sites: Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Google reviews.  
- Ask for references or case results in initial consultation.  
- Ask these specific questions in a consultation: How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled? What was the typical result? Will you personally handle my case or a junior attorney? What is your contingency fee and typical timeline? Do you go to trial if needed?

Want a shortlist?
If you tell me: (1) where in Atlanta the crash occurred, (2) date of the crash, (3) how severe your injuries and medical expenses are, and (4) whether the other driver was insured, I’ll generate a short list (3–5) of well-rated Atlanta personal-injury attorneys/firms and explain which look like the best fit for your circumstances.

Would you like me to find and shortlist attorneys now?
